source.title: Fish On Demand
source.description:
I hate fish. I cannot stand the smell of them. They are extremely creepy. Truly the worst.

Since this is my kitchen, I can and do exercise my authority to say NO to fish imports, but sometimes our soldiers get it in their heads that they need a fisherman's feast.

Tonight is one of those nights it would seem. I need fish, on the double!
source.objective: Investigate the boat docked south of New Avalon for a shipment of fish and return a haul back to Carrie.
source.progress:
Please don't deliver an incomplete order. I want to get it all out of the way at once.

If you can't get your hands on enough fish for the evening, maybe you can go scrounging for leftovers again. Truthfully I think that would be preferable.
source.completion:
Ah, I had hoped you had better things to do tonight but I suppose you have made yourself out to be quite dependable since we met.

Well. I had better get started.
